issue_context.title: Support insert and point_get for local temporary table

review_comments:
It's a little tricky here, because function `newMemBuffer` and `newMemDB` are invisible, so I have to creating a new txn instance and take out its MemBuffer.

Another approach is to mody tikv/go-client to export NewMemDB as public and modify newMemBuffer to NewMemBuffer. Which one is betweer?

You can see how it's done here https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/22440/files#diff-db24cdb418822855786d681d87e4d474988173aee00b6f8d93b3a550dd4a07e3R217-R221

When the local temporary table is created, a MemDB is also created.
When the transaction commits, the data are flushed to that MemDB

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/22440/files#diff-10dab83c04a99358d431906d37f48b92be97d50a2719d4ddf81c62d3b03a0aebR538

And read need to combine the MemDB (local temporary table data inside it)  with the transaction membuffer:

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/22440/files#diff-f7f3339231e4104abed7ddd0b9a3e12d2284761165df20d2141406104051767cR329-R338

I've studied this pr you listed, but it is a little old. KVStore has been moved to a single repo tikv/client-go.

But for the current pr, I just need a way to create a new MemDB, its not hard but should make a choice between:

1. Do not modify tikv/client-go , just use current code.
2. Modify codes in tikv/client-go, exporting function NewMemDB as public , it is still very simple.
Does it also apply to global temporary tables?

Yes, for global temporary table, they don't have any records in session, so it is equivalent to returning an empty result which is a right behavior. This code can keep unchanged when global table 'ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS' implemented.

Direct return make the TemporaryTableData dirty.
You need to call Cleanup/Release anyway.
